# Comprehensive QA Gate Checklist: Path-Based Risk Analytics & Trusted Extraction

**Purpose**: A rigorous, formal release gate for Peer Reviewers / QA to validate the completeness, clarity, and measurability of all requirements across simulation, AI extraction, and reporting.
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness
- [ ] CHK001 Are all necessary mathematical formulas and rounding rules defined for the Monte Carlo simulation outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the exact required contents for the advisor-ready PDF explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the validation rules for the 4th "Conflict" provenance state clearly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity
- [ ] CHK004 Is the definition of "implied cost percent" mathematically unambiguous for zero-cost structures like accumulators? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK005 Is "indicative margin/collateral impact" quantified with specific evaluation logic? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the 2008 and 2020 stress scenarios defined with exact, unambiguous parameter shocks? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]

## Requirement Consistency
- [ ] CHK007 Do the multi-underlying worst-of requirements align consistently with the path simulation percentile calculations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the "User-Verified" state reversion logic consistent across all editable fields? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality
- [ ] CHK009 Can the 5-second simulation performance target be objectively measured under specific load constraints? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the 95% missing-field detection rate statistically verifiable against the benchmark dataset? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements defined for when the public market-data source fails to fetch historical data? [Coverage, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements specified for when the user selects alternatives on different underlyings in Compare Mode? [Coverage, Alternate Flow]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for when the termsheet extraction service fails completely? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]

## Edge Case Coverage
- [ ] CHK014 Is the system behavior specified for when a gap move jumps across a knock-out barrier? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements defined for when a user supplies a non-positive semi-definite correlation matrix? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements specified for handling historical data gaps shorter than the product tenor? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements
- [ ] CHK017 Are PII redaction and zero-retention requirements strictly verifiable via automated audits? [NFR, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the session-storage boundary requirements for advisor branding explicitly defined? [NFR, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the definition of "strictly transiently in memory" quantified to satisfy the security model? [NFR, Spec §FR-033]

## Dependencies & Assumptions
- [ ] CHK020 Are the external dependency requirements for Google Vertex AI / GenAI SDK documented clearly? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the assumption of public market data availability validated against potential API rate limits? [Assumption, Gap]
